title: Restriction of a tower representing pair
statement: Fix the coefficient, field, separated finite-type scheme, ordinary derived tower, and open-operation setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude], [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], [lem-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-calculus] and [lem-sp-tower-binary-ctf-fibre]. Use the unchanged open-counit definitions of [def-sp-tower-binary-open-counit-data]. For h:Z→Y, compactification c, an open U in Z, an object K on Y and a good object P on U, suppose eU:F_U(P)→K represents Hom(F_U(-),K) on all good tests on U. For every open D≤U, restriction of P to D is good, and represents Hom(F_D(-),K) with the counit restrictedCounit(c,D≤U,P,K,eU), using the actual nested open adjunction map.

proof.text:
Let $i:D\hookrightarrow U$ be open, and let $t_i:i_!i^*P\to P$ be its adjunction counit. By the exact open adjunction and open composition normalization of [lem-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-calculus], for every $N\in\mathcal C_D$ there are bijections
$$\operatorname{Hom}_D(N,i^*P)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_U(i_!N,P)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_Y(F_Ui_!N,K)=\operatorname{Hom}_Y(F_DN,K).$$
The first sends $b$ to $t_i\circ i_!b$, and the second is the assumed representing bijection of $P$. Thus their composite is $b\mapsto\epsilon_U\circ F_U(t_i)\circ F_D(b)$, exactly the asserted restricted counit. The calculus preserves $\mathcal C$ under restriction and open extension, so every test object used here lies in the required category. Apply this also inside $V$ and to nested restrictions to $W$.

lean.statement:
theorem restricted_representing_pair
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hlp : l ≠ p)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p]
    (Z Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsSeparated Z.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Z.hom] [QuasiCompact Z.hom]
    [IsSeparated Y.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    (h : Z ⟶ Y) (c₀ : Compactification h.left)
    (U : Z.left.Opens) (K : D l E Y.left) (P : D l E U.toScheme)
    (hP : good l E b q U.toScheme P)
    (eU : (support l E b o c₀ U).obj P ⟶ K)
    (hU : Represents l E b q (support l E b o c₀ U) P K eU) :
    (∀ (D₀ : Z.left.Opens) (i : D₀ ≤ U),
      good l E b q D₀.toScheme ((restrictionBetween l E b o i).obj P) ∧
      Represents l E b q (support l E b o c₀ D₀)
        ((restrictionBetween l E b o i).obj P) K
        (restrictedCounit l E b o c₀ i P K eU))
